# Restaurant Radar — National & Global Competitive Venue Intelligence
> Competitive restaurant, bar, and hospitality venue intelligence platform serving independent operators, hospitality groups, and regional directors nationwide across the United States and expanding globally.

## Platform Overview
- **Platform Name:** Restaurant Radar
- **Geographic Scope:** National (United States) & Expanding Globally
- **Official Website:** https://restaurantradar.app/

## Verified Membership & Licensing Tiers (USD)
- **Founding Professional Tier (First 10 Venues):** $9 / month (vs. $150–$600/month enterprise restaurant analytics platforms)
- **Planned Verified Venue Tier:** $25 / month
- **Planned Featured Venue Tier:** $60 / month
- **City Operator License:** $199 / month
